name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahh, that yakiniku was so good~ Let's head home, Kei-chan~♪」
After parting ways with everyone else along the way, Kei-chan and I walk home together.
Speaking of Kei-chan, she's been walking slowly while glaring at empty space for a while now.
She must be looking at her holographic display set to private mode, deep in thought about something again.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Sigh, this is a problem.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hm~？ What's the problem, Kei-chan？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes... Never mind, though. Don't worry about it, Setsugekka.」
Hearing that makes me a little miffed.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aw, come on~ You can tell me, can't you? If you're in trouble, Kei-chan, I want to help you out.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, just focus on yourself. You don't need to worry about me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Treating me like a fool like that」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm always the one getting helped. You think someone like me can't be relied on, don't you!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's not it. I'm just worried about you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm worried about you too, Kei-chan, you know？」
Usually I'd back down right away, but for some reason, I just wasn't in the mood to do that today.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Phew, I suppose I have no choice. All right, I'll tell you everything.」
Kei-chan briskly points her hand toward me. She just sent something over holographically.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It's an encrypted email addressed to me that arrived a little while ago.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The sender is Makinojou-san, the head of the Kazamine Family.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh... From the Family Head？！」
I was shocked.
Including the branch families and extended relatives, the Kazamine Family is a massive household.
The one leading that massive household is the family head, Kazamine Makinojou-san—someone way above the clouds from my perspective.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um... 'Business Consultation' means the Family Head is asking you for a job directly？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, that's what it comes down to.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Way to go... That's amazing, Kei-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So basically, this means the Family Head recognized your abilities and asked you to take on a job, Kei-chan！？」
The next Family Head is decided by an election across the entire Kazamine Family.
However, with an endorsement from the current Head, a candidate's chances of being chosen are undoubtedly much higher.
In short, this is a massive opportunity for Kei-chan.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「True. It feels very much like a litmus test, but if I succeed, it will greatly open up the path to becoming Family Head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then you've definitely got to pull it off!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Still, as for whether I can accept it without hesitation, it's not quite that simple.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh, why？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I think you'll understand if you read it.」
At her prompting, I scan through the contents of the email.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let's see... 'Area management to handle risk management and build synergy for Kazamine Group subsidiaries expanding into Southeast Asia'... Huh？ What does that actually mean？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It means he wants me to oversee all the Kazamine Group companies and organizations expanding into Southeast Asia.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Whoa... That basically makes you a shadow ruler！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, I suppose it would.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You've got an offer this amazing and you're not going to take it？」
At my question, Kei-chan gives a wry smile.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If I accept this, I won't be able to stay in Japan anymore.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This job requires flying all across Southeast Asia, speaking directly with key figures, and building relationships with them.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It's not the kind of work I can do remotely from the academy, and I'd have to dedicate myself to it full-time for at least two... no, three years.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I see...」
In other words, if she takes this job, she won't be able to come back to Japan for two to three years at the earliest...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What's more, Makinojou-san seems to be in quite a hurry. I have to make my decision by the end of July at the latest.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's another reason I'm torn on how to respond.」
To think that while I was getting all excited about yakiniku, Kei-chan was agonizing over something like this...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm sorry... Here I was, getting all carried away by myself...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Silly, didn't I tell you not to worry about it？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This is my problem. All you need to think about is what's right in front of you—the Martial Festival.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But this is something really important to you, isn't it, Kei-chan?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, it is. But Setsugekka, this is an important time for you too, isn't it?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The reason I didn't tell you about this until today was because I wanted you to be able to focus on the Martial Festival.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I never meant to slight you or act like I don't rely on you—not in the slightest.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan...」
I see... Kei-chan was only keeping quiet for my sake, and here I went jumping to weird conclusions...

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If this ends up hurting your performance in the matches at all, I'll regret ever telling you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So please, forget about this. Devote yourself to what you must do.」
...I see. She's right.
Kei-chan already knows everything I'm thinking. She doesn't even need my help.
So all I need to think about is what's right in front of me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah... I understand. Sorry for making you worry, Kei-chan.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, it's alright.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But Kei-chan, let me say this up front.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No matter what path you choose from here on out, I'm going to follow you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because you and I are two in one, halves split from a single cell—right？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, we are.」
I couldn't tell what Kei-chan was thinking behind that smile, though.
Still, I just had to make sure she knew how I felt.
